A CLOSER LOOK

Different missions. A shared curiosity.

NASA began operations on October 1, 1958. Its work spans human exploration, robotic missions, Earth science, astronomy and research into flight. These selected missions introduce part of that larger story.

WHAT NASA EXPLORES

Space is only part of the story.

01 / OUR HOME PLANET

Understanding Earth

Satellites and scientific research help study the atmosphere, oceans, land and ice, and how these systems interact.

Explore Earth science ↗
02 / HUMANS IN SPACE

Living beyond Earth

Human spaceflight brings together spacecraft, life support, research and international teamwork. Explore NASA’s official pages for evolving mission plans.

Explore human spaceflight ↗
03 / THE SCIENCE OF FLIGHT

Improving aviation

The first “A” in NASA stands for Aeronautics. The agency also researches aircraft and the technologies that make flight possible.

Explore aeronautics ↗
